project.title: Multi-omics analysis of nitrite-driven anaerobic chain-elongation bioreactors
project.description: This BioProject contains 16S rRNA gene amplicon, metagenomic and metatranscriptomic sequencing data generated from laboratory-scale anaerobic chain-elongation bioreactors operated with or without low-dose nitrite addition. The study investigates how nitrite-associated nitrogen metabolism affects microbial community structure, carbon metabolism, reducing-power balance, energy conservation and medium-chain carboxylic acid production. Samples were collected from the nitrite-driven chain elongation system (NiCES) and a parallel control reactor during long-term operation.
project.center_name: Nanjing University of Science and Technology
